title: Bengal Higher Secondary Semester III results: 92.62% pass, Nadia tops districts
dek: Of about 7.03 lakh candidates, 6.51 lakh passed, slightly fewer than last year. No merit list was published.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education on Friday declared the results of the Higher Secondary Semester III examinations, with 92.62% of candidates passing, down from 93.37% last year, according to reports.

Of 7,02,997 candidates who sat the exams, held between 21 September and 14 October, 6,51,129 passed. Girls and boys did almost equally well: 92.66% of the 3,93,179 girls and 92.58% of the 3,09,818 boys passed. Nadia had the highest district pass rate at 95.58%, followed by Purba Medinipur at 95.09% and Howrah at 95.08%; Kolkata was eighth at 93.45%.

By stream, 98.11% passed in the mainly commerce subject group and 98% in science, while 91% passed in the arts group, which had the most candidates. About 45% of those who passed scored 60% or more, and 9,693 students, or 1.48%, scored 90% or above.

As in the semester system's earlier rounds, no merit list was published. Marksheets carry QR codes and show subject-wise scores and any subjects needing a supplementary exam; heads of schools have been asked to download, sign and stamp the results and hand printed copies to students. The results came 44 days after the last paper.
